title: Regulatory Directive on the Discontinuation of Some Fixed-Dose Combination (FDC) Drugs
action: Discontinuation of registration of specified fixed-dose combination drug products
summary: NAFDAC directs the discontinuation of registration of 338 specified fixed-dose combination (FDC) drug products. Manufacturers and importers must cease registration renewal for affected combinations.
scope: All manufacturers, importers, and distributors of the listed FDC products in Nigeria

title: Regulatory Directive on Discontinued Registration of Halofantrine Tablet
action: Discontinuation of registration of Halofantrine tablet formulations
summary: NAFDAC directs the discontinuation of registration of Halofantrine tablet products due to safety concerns.
scope: All Halofantrine tablet products

title: Regulatory Directive on Discontinued Registration of Ketoconazole Tablet
action: Discontinuation of registration of Ketoconazole oral tablet formulations
summary: NAFDAC directs the discontinuation of registration of Ketoconazole oral tablet products due to hepatotoxicity and drug interaction risks. Topical ketoconazole formulations are not affected.
scope: Ketoconazole oral tablet formulations only; topical (cream, shampoo) forms are excluded

title: Regulatory Directive on Discontinued Registration of Chloroquine Injection
action: Discontinuation of registration of Chloroquine injection formulations
summary: NAFDAC directs the discontinuation of registration of Chloroquine injection products. Oral chloroquine formulations are not affected by this directive.
scope: Chloroquine injection formulations only

title: Regulatory Directive on Discontinued Registration of Analgin (Metamizole / Novalgin / Dipyrone) Formulations
action: Discontinuation of registration of Analgin/Metamizole/Novalgin/Dipyrone oral and injectable formulations
summary: NAFDAC directs the discontinuation of registration of Analgin (generic: Metamizole, also known as Novalgin or Dipyrone) formulations due to risk of agranulocytosis and other serious haematological adverse reactions.
scope: All Metamizole / Analgin / Novalgin / Dipyrone oral and injectable formulations

title: Regulatory Directive on Discontinued Registration of Diclofenac Potassium 100mg
action: Discontinuation of registration of Diclofenac Potassium 100mg formulations
summary: NAFDAC directs the discontinuation of registration of Diclofenac Potassium 100mg formulations. Lower-strength Diclofenac Potassium formulations and Diclofenac Sodium products are not directly covered by this directive.
scope: Diclofenac Potassium 100mg formulations specifically

title: Regulatory Directive on the Registration of Cyproheptadine 2mg and 4mg in Combination with Multivitamin Formulations
action: Discontinuation/restriction of registration of Cyproheptadine-Multivitamin combination formulations
summary: NAFDAC issues a directive concerning the registration of Cyproheptadine 2mg and 4mg in combination with Multivitamin formulations. Consult the official directive for precise registration requirements and restrictions.
scope: Cyproheptadine 2mg and 4mg in combination with Multivitamin formulations

title: Regulatory Directive on Discontinued Registration of Multi-Dose Antimalaria Oral Suspensions
action: Discontinuation of registration of multi-dose antimalaria oral suspension products
summary: NAFDAC directs the discontinuation of registration of multi-dose antimalaria oral suspension products due to stability and dosing accuracy concerns.
scope: Multi-dose antimalaria oral suspension formulations

title: Regulatory Directive on Sale, Use and Distribution of Dichlorvos (DDVP) 100ml Pack Size
action: Restriction on sale, use and distribution of Dichlorvos (DDVP) products in pack sizes of 100ml or less
summary: NAFDAC restricts the sale, use and distribution of Dichlorvos (DDVP) products in pack sizes up to 100ml due to toxicity and public safety concerns.
scope: Dichlorvos (DDVP) products in pack sizes of 100ml or less

title: Regulatory Directive on the Ban on Antrazine
action: Ban on Antrazine (Atrazine-containing products)
summary: NAFDAC bans Antrazine (an atrazine-based herbicide/pesticide product) from manufacture, importation, distribution, and use in Nigeria.
scope: All Antrazine (Atrazine-containing) products

title: Regulatory Directive on the Use of Antibiotics as Growth Promoters in Livestock and Poultry Production
action: Prohibition of the use of antibiotics as growth promoters in livestock and poultry production
summary: NAFDAC prohibits the use of antibiotics as growth promoters in livestock and poultry production in Nigeria to combat antimicrobial resistance.
scope: All antibiotics used as growth promoters in livestock and poultry production

title: Regulatory Directive on the Use of Banned Veterinary Pharmaceuticals in Food-Producing Animals
action: Prohibition of importation, manufacture, distribution, sale, or use of banned veterinary drugs in food-producing animals
summary: NAFDAC prohibits the importation, manufacture, distribution, sale, or use of banned veterinary drugs and pharmaceuticals in food-producing animals in Nigeria.
scope: All banned veterinary drugs and pharmaceuticals used in food-producing animals

title: Regulatory Directive on the Use of Colistin as Coccidiostat
action: Restriction/ban on use of Colistin as a coccidiostat in veterinary/poultry production
summary: NAFDAC restricts/bans the use of Colistin as a coccidiostat in veterinary and poultry production to preserve Colistin as a last-resort antibiotic for human medicine.
scope: Colistin used as a coccidiostat in veterinary/poultry production

title: Regulatory Directive on the Use of Ethoxyquin in Feed for Food-Producing Animals
action: Restriction on the use of Ethoxyquin in feed for food-producing animals
summary: NAFDAC restricts the use of Ethoxyquin (a feed preservative/antioxidant) in feed for food-producing animals due to safety concerns over residues in animal products.
scope: Ethoxyquin used in feed for food-producing animals

title: Regulatory Directive on the Use of Antibiotics and Gentian Violet as Mould Inhibitor
action: Prohibition of the use of antibiotics and Gentian Violet as mould inhibitors in food/feed
summary: NAFDAC prohibits the use of antibiotics and Gentian Violet as mould inhibitors, due to toxicity, carcinogenicity concerns, and antimicrobial resistance risks.
scope: Antibiotics and Gentian Violet used as mould inhibitors in food or feed production

title: Regulatory Directive on the Ban on Paraquat
action: Ban on Paraquat-containing products
summary: NAFDAC bans Paraquat-containing products from manufacture, importation, distribution, and use in Nigeria.
scope: All Paraquat-containing products

title: NAFDAC Regulatory Directive on Donated Medical Products in Nigeria
action: Regulatory requirements for the importation and distribution of donated medical products
summary: NAFDAC sets regulatory requirements governing the importation and distribution of donated medical products in Nigeria.
scope: All organizations involved in the importation and distribution of donated medical products in Nigeria

title: Regulatory Directive on Revised Registration Timelines
action: Revised timelines for drug product registration review
summary: NAFDAC issues revised timelines for pharmaceutical product registration review processes. Superseded by the August 2026 revised timelines directive.
scope: All applicants for drug product registration in Nigeria

title: Regulatory Directive on Regulatory Reliance
action: Guidelines and conditions for regulatory reliance on decisions of other reference regulatory authorities
summary: NAFDAC issues a directive on regulatory reliance, specifying conditions under which NAFDAC may rely on assessments of recognised reference regulatory authorities (RRAs) for product registration.
scope: Applicants for drug product registration seeking reliance on reference regulatory authority decisions

title: Regulatory Directive on Risk Management Plan
action: Requirement for Risk Management Plans (RMP) for specified medicinal products
summary: NAFDAC requires marketing authorization holders to submit Risk Management Plans (RMPs) for specified categories of medicinal products.
scope: Marketing Authorization Holders of specified medicinal products in Nigeria

title: Regulatory Directive on QPPV Appointment
action: Mandatory appointment of a Qualified Person for Pharmacovigilance (QPPV)
summary: NAFDAC requires all Marketing Authorization Holders to appoint a Qualified Person for Pharmacovigilance (QPPV) responsible for pharmacovigilance activities.
scope: All Marketing Authorization Holders in Nigeria

title: Regulatory Directive on Safety App
action: Mandatory use of NAFDAC Safety App for reporting adverse drug reactions and substandard/falsified products
summary: NAFDAC directs the mandatory use of the NAFDAC Safety App for reporting adverse drug reactions and substandard or falsified medical products.
scope: All healthcare professionals, Marketing Authorization Holders, and the public in Nigeria

title: Regulatory Directive on the Suspension of New Applications Under the Global Listing Scheme
action: Suspension of new applications under the Global Listing Scheme; conditions for processing renewal applications
summary: NAFDAC suspends new product registration applications under the Global Listing Scheme and specifies conditions for the processing of renewal applications under the scheme.
scope: Applicants seeking registration under the NAFDAC Global Listing Scheme

title: Regulatory Directive on the Enforcement of the Pharmaceutical Products (Traceability) Regulations, 2024
action: Enforcement of the Pharmaceutical Products (Traceability) Regulations, 2024
summary: NAFDAC directs the enforcement of the Pharmaceutical Products (Traceability) Regulations, 2024, requiring pharmaceutical product track-and-trace compliance.
scope: All manufacturers, importers, and distributors of pharmaceutical products in Nigeria

title: Regulatory Directive on Ceftriaxone Co-Packaged with Lidocaine and Water for Injection (WFI)
action: Regulatory requirements for co-packaged Ceftriaxone with Lidocaine and Water for Injection
summary: NAFDAC issues a directive on the requirements for Ceftriaxone co-packaged with Lidocaine and Water for Injection (WFI) products. Consult the official directive for precise requirements.
scope: Ceftriaxone products co-packaged with Lidocaine and/or Water for Injection

title: Regulatory Directive on Mandatory Submission of Drug Master File (DMF) in Product Dossiers
action: Mandatory submission of Drug Master File (DMF) as part of product registration dossiers
summary: NAFDAC makes the submission of a Drug Master File (DMF) mandatory as part of pharmaceutical product registration dossiers.
scope: All applicants for pharmaceutical product registration in Nigeria

title: Regulatory Directive on Revised Registration Timelines (August 2026)
action: Revised timelines for drug product registration review (supersedes October 2025 directive)
summary: NAFDAC issues updated/revised timelines for pharmaceutical product registration review, superseding the October 2025 registration timelines directive.
scope: All applicants for drug product registration in Nigeria

title: Regulatory Directive on Levamisole-Containing Human Medicinal Products
action: Regulatory action on levamisole-containing human medicinal products
summary: NAFDAC issues a regulatory directive concerning levamisole-containing human medicinal products. Consult the official directive for the specific action and scope.
scope: Levamisole-containing human medicinal products

title: Regulatory Directive on PSUR/PBRER
action: Submission of Periodic Safety Update Reports (PSUR) / Periodic Benefit-Risk Evaluation Reports (PBRER)
summary: NAFDAC requires Marketing Authorization Holders to submit PSUR/PBRER as per the directive schedule.
scope: All Marketing Authorization Holders in Nigeria

title: Regulatory Directive on Reporting Timelines — Pharmacovigilance
action: Compliance with pharmacovigilance reporting timelines
summary: NAFDAC specifies mandatory pharmacovigilance reporting timelines for adverse drug reactions and safety signals.
scope: All Marketing Authorization Holders and healthcare professionals in Nigeria

title: Regulatory Directive on Pharmacovigilance Activities for Local Marketing Authorization Holders (MAHs)
action: Pharmacovigilance obligations for local Marketing Authorization Holders
summary: NAFDAC specifies pharmacovigilance activities required of local Marketing Authorization Holders.
scope: Local Marketing Authorization Holders in Nigeria

title: Regulatory Directive on the Formulation of Veterinary Products with Not More Than Two Antimicrobials
action: Restriction on formulation of veterinary products containing more than two antimicrobials
summary: NAFDAC restricts veterinary antimicrobial product formulations to not more than two antimicrobial agents.
scope: Veterinary antimicrobial product manufacturers and importers
